# Premium menu visual fixtures

These photographs exist only for `premium-reference.browser.mjs`. Playwright intercepts the fixture image requests; the app never imports them or substitutes them for a branch product image. Prices, products and availability in those captures are controlled test data, not a production catalogue.

The built-in image-generation tool reconstructed the supplied three-screen concept's food-photo style. An eight-square 4-by-2 atlas supplied thali, bhature, rasgulla, kaju katli, dahi, cola, biscuits and namkeen. A separate square chocolate cake image supplies the bakery shortcut and discovery rail. WebP derivatives are 400 pixels square.

Prompt specification: premium photoreal studio food photographs matching the supplied reference composition and pale peach/mint/lavender backgrounds; no UI, text, watermark or product brand. The atlas uses exactly four columns and two rows in the order listed above; the cake is a triangular layered chocolate slice with smooth frosting and a piped rosette.

Production editorial assets are `public/menu-sweets-banner.webp` and `public/menu-snacks-banner.webp`, reconstructed with the same built-in tool. Their prompts specify the reference's wide peach rasgulla/kaju-katli arrangement and mint namkeen/cookies/chips arrangement respectively, with an empty left area for live HTML text and no generated lettering. They are decorative campaign artwork, not catalogue product photographs.
